574: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("StartSlowerBattlersActFirst",
575:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
576:     # Get the speeds of all battlers
577:     ally_speeds = []
578:     foe_speeds = []
579:     ai.each_battler do |b, i|
580:       if b.opposes?(user)
581:         foe_speeds.push(b.rough_stat(:SPEED))
582:         foe_speeds.last *= 2 if user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::Tailwind] > 1
583:         foe_speeds.last /= 2 if user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::Swamp] > 1
584:       else
585:         ally_speeds.push(b.rough_stat(:SPEED))
586:         ally_speeds.last *= 2 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Tailwind] > 1
587:         ally_speeds.last /= 2 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Swamp] > 1
588:       end
589:     end
590:     # Just in case a side has no battlers
591:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if ally_speeds.length == 0 || foe_speeds.length == 0
592:     # Invert the speeds if Trick Room applies (and will last longer than this round)
593:     if battle.field.effects[PBEffects::TrickRoom] > 1
594:       foe_speeds.map! { |val| 100_000 - val }    # 100_000 is higher than speed can
595:       ally_speeds.map! { |val| 100_000 - val }   # possibly be; only order matters
596:     end
597:     # Score based on the relative speeds
598:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if ally_speeds.min > foe_speeds.max
599:     if foe_speeds.min > ally_speeds.max
600:       score += 20
601:     elsif ally_speeds.sum / ally_speeds.length < foe_speeds.sum / foe_speeds.length
602:       score += 10
603:     else
604:       score -= 10
605:     end
606:     next score
607:   }
